thread:
alex: Heads-up: after the quantize-based routing tweak landed p50 looks fine but p95/p99 for endpoint /v1/generate jumped ~200ms. anyone else seeing this?
jamie: saw it on dashboards, roughly same time as the policy change. p50 stable, tail up.
maria: which endpoint slice? frontend or internal tf-serving?
alex: /v1/generate (public) — split by model-variant. The routing change quantizes small payloads to CPU fallback faster.
jamal: quick check: ran a percentile query with cohorts: 
```
SELECT percentile(lat_ms, 50,95,99) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND model='redwood-7b' GROUP BY slice
```
Found p99 up on slice=variant-b (cache miss-heavy)
jamie: looks like traffic shifted ~12% to variant-b after the policy. variant-b has higher cold-kv cache miss penalty.
linda: did we bump batch window or change kvcache routing?
maria: not kvcache config; policy adjusted routing weights to favor quantized CPU when payload < 64 tokens. maybe that interacts with backend path.
product-ux: UX question — console shows p50/p95/p99 stacked, but no provenance tag for 'routing policy change' — can we flag changes?
alex: +1 for flagging. For now we should verify whether the p99 is real or an aggregation artifact.
jamal: quick hist sample: variant-b tail is real — 2k samples with p99 ~ 420ms vs baseline 180ms.
jamie: likely cause: variant-b runs on hosts with slower NVMe or priority queue.
linda: I can run an infra diff on variant-b host fleet.
maria: also check retries — if quantized path does extra retry/translation step for small payloads maybe extra latency.
jamal: logs show extra proxy-hop for quantized routing: `proxy->quantizer->backend`.
alex: action items: linda to audit fleet config, jamal to confirm extra hop cost and retry counts, product-ux to add a console annotation for routing policy change, jamie to draft a roll-back criteria if p99 > 300ms for 10min.
linda: ack, starting fleet audit.
jamal: I'll paste a quick sample in #incidents if I find host-level skew.
product-ux: I'll open a console issue for annotation and tie to rollout window.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T15:42:10Z — quantize-routing v2 to prod (by infra/rollout).
alex: thanks — will follow up once we have fleet audit.
jamie: if anyone spots spike in EU region, ping me.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
